# ERP numeric-field focus and steppers

Update, 18 October: see [shared numeric entry and fuzzy ERP search](number-fields-fuzzy-search-2026-10-18.md) for current zero-on-focus, wheel and matching behavior. The implementation history below is retained.

Use the existing HisabIQ design-package Input, extended through one NumericInput wrapper. Numeric fields show subtle up/down chevrons on hover or focus, including click/tap focus. ArrowUp/ArrowDown and pointer buttons change the value by exactly one whole unit: 12.50 → 13.50, 170.25 → 171.25. Exact decimal-string arithmetic avoids floating-point tails. Existing bounds apply; blank starts at zero, negative values remain permitted only where the source field allows them. Disabled/read-only fields expose no steppers. Native number arrows are hidden so there is only one consistent control.

The shared Input routes decimal/number/integer numeric fields through this wrapper. Raw POS/Purchase/cart/checkout/compound-quantity/MoneyUnitInput fields use the same control. Original props, refs, onChange, validation, calculations, unit switching, Enter and F2/F8/F9 remain intact. Phone, identifiers, search, date and text controls keep their original behavior. Both parts of compound units step independently. On phones, compound quantities use a full card row so the arrows cannot crowd out the values. Existing #72 POS/shared cart wrappers are reused as well as the Purchase wrappers; no transaction handlers are replaced. Price-eye and lot-unit accessories reserve their own space; touch fields provide 24px arrow targets in 48px controls. Light/dark use current tokens, and reduced motion removes the reveal transition.

Payment totals are not recalculated by the stepper. A real input event runs the original React change path, so the existing calculations and safety guards remain the authority. Minimum/maximum and invalid text do not invent a valid transaction. Updated the joined-control regression to assert the same bordered numeric/unit group instead of relying on the old immediate input parent.

Validation: whole-unit exact-decimal/bounds tests; ten full 320/390/768/1024/1440px light/dark browser runs for hover, focus, pointer, keys, live subtotal, decimal typing and Enter/F2; compound units, product quick-add/unit conversion, full purchase create, Purchase source workflows and Expense actions. Strict TypeScript, lint, build and UI contract are required. Stack after #81; no merge without approval.
